lines.text: Many learners say: Please you open the window.

native.tip: Kita bilang “Tolong kamu buka jendelanya.” Di bahasa Inggris, setelah please langsung kata kerja: open, tanpa you.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “Please you open the window.” 😅 Setelah please, langsung kata kerja: “Please open the window.” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “open”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “Please open the window.” lalu tulis satu permintaan sopan untuk temanmu. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “Tolong kamu buka jendelanya.” In English, after please put the verb right away: open, without you.
en.caption: Ever say this? “Please you open the window.” 😅 After please, go straight to the verb: “Please open the window.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
